description: This Java source file defines a MessageAggregator class that extends Akka's AbstractActorWithTimers. It forwards its first message to a specified recipient, waits for a set number of messages of a certain type within a timeout, then sends the collected messages back to the original sender and stops itself.

classes.name: MessageAggregator
classes.description: A generic Akka actor that aggregates a fixed number of messages of type T, with a timeout, forwarding the first message and returning the collected messages to the sender.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Static factory method to create Props for the MessageAggregator actor with specified initial receiver, message class, expected message count, and timeout.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the initial message handling behavior, forwarding the first message and transitioning to listening behavior.

methods.name: listeningBehavior
methods.description: Defines behavior to collect messages of type T until expected count is reached or timeout occurs.

methods.name: handleTimeout
methods.description: Handles timeout event, logs error, and triggers report and stop.

methods.name: reportAndStop
methods.description: Sends collected messages back to the original sender and stops the actor.
